title: AI Media 5/5 - end-to-end acceptance
description: Final verification of D:-first storage, detected applications and image/video/audio/voice assets. Produces acceptance evidence without moving existing LLM models from D:.
test: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$p='D:/AI-Media/state/final-report.json';if(-not(Test-Path $p)){throw 'final report missing'};$r=Get-Content $p -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($r.cache -notlike 'D:*' -or $r.outputs -notlike 'D:*' -or $r.llmModels -notlike 'D:*'){throw 'D-first policy failed'};foreach($x in @($r.imageModel,$r.videoModel,$r.audioModel,$r.piper,$r.voiceModel)){if(-not(Test-Path $x)){throw ('asset missing '+$x)}};Write-Host 'AI_MEDIA_ACCEPTANCE_TEST=PASS'
rollback: Write-Host 'Acceptance is read-only apart from report generation.'
